newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine's Kuchma calls for currency corridor.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine's Kuchma calls for currency corridor.

text.p: Ukrainian President Leonid Kuchma on Friday called for adoption of a currency corridor or trading band for the hryvnia as a way of boosting the former Soviet republic's export potential.

"We must continue to liberalise our money, implement a currency corridor, and cancel rules making residents buy hard currency," Kuchma told the government and parliament during his annual address to the nation of 51 million people.
Kuchma also said Ukraine needed to seek full convertability for the hryvnia, in line with the International Monetary Fund's Article Eight.
Economists and reformers in Ukraine have been discussing the idea of a currency corridor for years but it was one of the few times the president has referred to it specifically.
